note: Permissive-licensed vulnerability/fix pairs reduced from upstream open-source projects (code verbatim-derived; only packaging and dependencies removed for offline reduction). One entry per variant; variant dirs a/b per family, the letter does not reveal which is vulnerable (recorded only here). Both findings of a pair share title and description. Truth is evaluator-only and never enters an agent input. Vulnerable -> potentially_exploitable; fixed -> likely_not_exploitable. Per-case upstream provenance and SPDX licence in each family's provenance.json and in SOURCE.md.
